test_cases.test_scenario: BUSINESS FLOW 1 (SEQUENTIAL UPDATE): AN END-TO-END USER JOURNEY - Phase 1: Teacher Initializes and Sets Up the Course
test_cases.test_case_title: Teacher logs into the system with valid credentials
test_cases.pre_condition: A Teacher with a pre-provisioned account exists in the system with the username 'GiangGiangteacher@gmail.com' and password 'ValidPassword123!Giangteacher'. The system is online and able to process authentication requests. The Teacher is currently logged out and on the Landing Page.
test_cases.expected_result: The user is authenticated, their session is initiated, and they are redirected to the Dashboard Page.
test_cases.post_condition: The Teacher is logged into the system and is on the Dashboard Page. The Teacher's session is initiated.

test_steps.step: Click the 'Login' button on the Navbar to open the login modal.
Click the 'Log In' button to submit credentials.
